name: Aeroplane
description: '''Vito de Luca''', better known as '''Aeroplane''', is a Belgian [[nu disco]] [[Record producer|music producer]] and [[Disc jockey|DJ]]. Formerly a duo consisting of Vito de Luca and '''Stephen Fasano''' (currently known as [[The Magician (musician)|The Magician]]), the latter member left in 2010. Known for incorporating a mix of French house and balearic beat, Aeroplane made a name for himself as a club DJ.{{By whom|date=August 2026}}
